instruction: Merge all .txt files from the VS Code project into 'reverse_merge.docx' on the Desktop in reverse order (5.txt first, then 4.txt, 3.txt, 2.txt, 1.txt last) using LibreOffice Writer. Set font size to 11.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully merged all 5 .txt files into concat.docx on Desktop using VS Code terminal and LibreOffice Writer, set font size to 10, and saved as .docx format.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can use VS Code terminal to concatenate files, open LibreOffice Writer, select all text, change font size, save as .docx via Save As dialog, navigate file system.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests reverse-order file merging, requiring the agent to concatenate files in a specific non-default order (5 to 1 instead of 1 to 5).
metadata.explanation: Task requires merging all .txt files in reverse numerical order into a docx. Evaluator checks: (1) text starts with 5.txt content, (2) text ends with 1.txt content, (3) all 5 files present, (4) font size is 11.
